body.name: Fully specified replacement realization fiber
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)=\{\widetilde\eta\in\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}:(G_0(\widetilde\eta),(T_k(\widetilde\eta))_{k=1}^{K})=\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)\}\). The defining predicate fixes the graphical and target components only; the kernel family \(\kappa(\widetilde\eta)\) is part of each fully specified member and is not inherited from \(\eta\).
